subcategories.title: 通用产品识别母提示词 (Master Prompt)
subcategories.scene_desc: 适合每次上传白底图后的首发指令，自动识别产品类别、材质、造型，锁定产品100%一致性并判断欧美消费场景。
subcategories.target: 全品类通用 / Gemini / GPT Image
subcategories.prompt:
You are a professional commercial product photographer and art director specializing in Amazon, Shopify, and premium independent e-commerce brands targeting US and European markets.

Analyze the uploaded product image carefully.

First identify:
- product category (kitchen knife / outdoor knife / scissors / kitchen accessory)
- material and finish
- shape and design characteristics
- realistic Western usage scenarios
- target customer group (home cook, chef, outdoor enthusiast, professional)
- market positioning (premium daily use / professional / gift)

Based on real selling environments on Amazon US, European retailers, and independent lifestyle brands, create a realistic lifestyle product photography scene.

The product in the reference image must remain 100% identical:
- same shape, dimensions, blade geometry, handle design, texture, color, and details

Do not redesign the product. Do not add extra parts. Do not modify the structure.

Create a realistic commercial photo suitable for independent website product pages, e-commerce homepage, and brand marketing banners.

The image must look like a real professional photograph, not AI generated.

Requirements: natural lighting, real environment, realistic human interaction, authentic materials, subtle imperfections, premium but believable atmosphere, professional product photography, high-end lifestyle commercial photography for Western audiences.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
你是一位专业商业产品摄影师与艺术总监，专注于面向美国与欧洲市场的 Amazon、Shopify 及高端独立站品牌。

仔细分析上传的产品图片。

首先识别：
- 产品品类（厨房刀 / 户外刀 / 剪刀 / 厨房配件）
- 材质与表面处理
- 造型与设计特征
- 真实的欧美使用场景
- 目标客户群体（家庭厨娘、专业厨师、户外爱好者、专业人士）
- 市场定位（日常高端 / 专业 / 礼品）

基于 Amazon 美国站、欧洲零售商与独立生活方式品牌的真实销售环境，创建逼真的生活方式产品摄影场景。

参考图中的产品必须保持 100% 一致：造型、尺寸、刃型、柄型、纹理、颜色与细节均不可改变。

请勿重新设计产品、添加部件或修改结构。

创建适用于独立站产品页、电商首页与品牌营销 Banner 的逼真商业照片。

图片必须看起来像真实专业摄影师拍摄，而非 AI 生成。

要求：自然光线、真实环境、逼真人体交互、真实材质、细微自然瑕疵、高端但可信的氛围、专业产品摄影、面向欧美客户的高端生活方式商业摄影。

subcategories.title: QC：产品100%一致性锁定
subcategories.scene_desc: 防翻车必备，防止 AI 改刀型、刃弧、手柄铆钉或加假 Logo。
subcategories.prompt:
PRODUCT IDENTITY PROTECTION:

The uploaded product is the exact product reference.

Maintain 100% identical: overall shape, dimensions, proportions, blade geometry, blade curve, blade thickness, handle design, screws, rivets, texture, logo position, material appearance.

Do not redesign, improve, modify, simplify, or add decorative elements.

The product must look like the same physical item photographed in another environment.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
产品身份保护：

上传产品为精准参考。保持 100% 一致：整体造型、尺寸、比例、刀刃几何与弧度、厚度、手柄设计、螺丝、铆钉、纹理、Logo 位置、材质外观。

严禁重新设计、改进、修改、简化或添加装饰。

产品必须像在另一环境中拍摄的同一实体物品。

subcategories.title: QC：刀刃纹理与金属真实感
subcategories.scene_desc: 保护大马士革纹、拉丝、镜面等金属物理质感。
subcategories.prompt:
BLADE DETAIL PRESERVATION & METAL REALISM:

Preserve original blade characteristics: Damascus pattern, steel grain, brushed metal texture, polished reflection, edge line, grinding marks.

Do not create fake patterns or replace blade material.

Create realistic stainless steel behavior that follows environment lighting, shows natural highlights, and maintains metal texture.

Avoid chrome mirror effect, liquid metal, plastic appearance, CGI rendering.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 刀刃细节与金属真实感：保留大马士革纹、钢材纹理、拉丝质感、抛光光泽、刃线、研磨痕迹。禁止虚假纹理或替换材质。呈现遵循环境光的自然高光与金属质感。避免电镀镜面、液态金属、塑料感与 CGI 渲染。

subcategories.title: QC：手部真实度与使用逻辑
subcategories.scene_desc: 防止多指、畸形手或不合理使用姿势。
subcategories.prompt:
HUMAN HAND REALISM & REAL WORLD USAGE LOGIC:

If human interaction is shown: hands must be anatomically correct with exactly five fingers, natural grip, realistic wrist angle, and correct product holding position.

Avoid extra fingers, missing fingers, strange hand shapes, impossible holding.

Usage must match real purpose:
- Kitchen knife: cut food ingredients
- Outdoor knife: camping, rope, wood, outdoor prep
- Garden scissors: plants, branches, flowers
- Tailor scissors: fabric, textile

Do not create unrealistic usage scenarios.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 真人手部与使用逻辑：手部必须解剖正确（五指、自然握持、真实手腕角度）。禁止多余/缺失手指与畸形姿势。用途必须符合现实：厨刀切食材、户外刀野营切绳削木、园艺剪修枝、裁缝剪裁布。禁止不合逻辑的使用场景。

subcategories.title: QC：通用负面控制词
subcategories.scene_desc: 剔除 AI 感、CGI、假光影与夸张渲染。
subcategories.prompt:
NEGATIVE PROMPT:

Do not create: AI generated look, CGI render, 3D model appearance, unrealistic materials, fake reflections, exaggerated colors, impossible physics, distorted products, changed product design, wrong proportions, extra objects, fake human hands.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 负面提示词：切勿生成 AI 感、CGI 渲染、3D 模型外观、不真实材质、虚假反射、夸张色彩、不可能物理效果、变形产品、被改设计、错误比例、多余物体、假人手。

subcategories.title: QC 刀具结构保护 Knife Structure
subcategories.scene_desc: 锁定刃长厚度尖端刀脊柄比例，禁止幻想刀型。
subcategories.prompt:
KNIFE STRUCTURE PROTECTION:

Maintain: blade length, blade thickness, edge angle, tip shape, spine design, handle proportion.

The knife blade must not become longer, shorter, wider, curved, or different shape.

Keep original manufacturing design. No fantasy knife design.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 刀具结构保护：保持刃长、厚度、刃角、尖端、刀脊、柄比例。刀刃不得变长变短变宽弯曲。保持原厂设计，禁止幻想刀型。

subcategories.title: QC 剪刀结构保护
subcategories.scene_desc: 锁定刃长指孔支点开合角度。
subcategories.prompt:
SCISSORS STRUCTURE LOCK:

Maintain: blade length, handle size, finger hole shape, pivot position, opening angle.

Do not change number of holes, handle shape, blade curvature.

The scissors must remain the same real product.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 剪刀结构锁定：保持刃长、手柄尺寸、指孔形状、支点、开合角度。禁止改变孔数、柄形、刃弧。必须是同一真实产品。

subcategories.title: QC 欧美审美过滤器
subcategories.scene_desc: 北欧厨房、现代美式、户外冒险、专业工艺。拒绝廉价电商风。
subcategories.prompt:
EUROPEAN AMERICAN DESIGN STYLE:

The image should communicate: premium, clean, functional, professional, natural lifestyle.

Preferred styles: Scandinavian kitchen, modern American home, outdoor adventure, professional craftsmanship.

Avoid: cheap marketplace style, over decorated Chinese ecommerce style, fake luxury.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 欧美设计风格：传递高端、干净、实用、专业、自然生活。偏好：北欧厨房、现代美式家居、户外冒险、专业工艺。避免：廉价市场风、过度装饰中国电商风、假奢华。

subcategories.title: QC 最终商业摄影总控
subcategories.scene_desc: 成片前统一追加。专业单反、自然光、物理材质。
subcategories.prompt:
FINAL COMMERCIAL PHOTOGRAPHY PROMPT:

Create a real professional commercial photograph.
The uploaded product is the exact physical product. Do not modify the product.
Create a realistic usage environment.
The image should look like a professional brand photoshoot.
Camera: professional DSLR. Lens: 35mm / 50mm / 85mm.
Lighting: natural commercial lighting. Materials: physically accurate. People: realistic human interaction.
Suitable for international ecommerce, brand website, advertising campaign. No AI appearance.
subcategories.prompt_zh: 最终商业摄影总控：创建真实专业商业照片。上传产品为精确实体，禁止修改。创建真实使用环境。应像专业品牌拍摄。相机专业单反，镜头35/50/85mm，自然商业光，材质物理准确，人物交互真实。适用于国际电商、品牌官网、广告。无AI感。

subcategories.title: Chef / Gyuto · 欧美现代家庭厨房切菜
subcategories.scene_desc: 主厨刀/牛刀最常用场景。明亮欧美开放式厨房，木砧板与新鲜蔬果，自然窗光。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic premium kitchen lifestyle photograph of a Western home cook using the uploaded chef knife (or gyuto).

Scene: bright modern European-American open-plan kitchen with white or light oak cabinets, marble or quartz island, large window with soft natural daylight.

Show: natural hand holding the knife correctly in a pinch grip, wooden cutting board, fresh vegetables (herbs, tomatoes, onions), clean premium workspace.

Style: professional food magazine photography, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, authentic materials, subtle real-life imperfections. No staged plastic look.

Keep the knife 100% identical to the reference. The image must look like a real commercial photograph for a US/EU independent kitchen brand.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张欧美家庭厨娘使用上传主厨刀（或牛刀）的逼真高端厨房生活方式照片。

场景：明亮现代欧美开放式厨房，白色或浅橡木橱柜、大理石/石英岛台、大窗柔和自然光。

展示：自然手部以正确捏握姿势持刀、木质砧板、新鲜蔬果香草、干净高端台面。

风格：专业美食杂志摄影、50mm 镜头感、浅景深、真实材质与细微生活痕迹。禁止塑料感摆拍。

刀具须与参考图 100% 一致。图像须像真实面向美欧独立厨具品牌的商业照片。

subcategories.title: Chef / Gyuto · 专业餐厅后厨备餐
subcategories.scene_desc: 高端主厨刀卖点图。不锈钢工作台、厨师手部、新鲜食材，传递专业锋利与可靠。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic professional restaurant kitchen scene featuring the uploaded chef knife.

Scene: high-end Western restaurant prep area with stainless steel counters, organized mise en place, fresh proteins and vegetables.

Show: chef hands using the knife with precision, sharp clean cuts, professional atmosphere under realistic kitchen lighting.

Style: culinary documentary / Michelin kitchen commercial photography. Communicate sharpness, control, and professional reliability.

Keep the knife exactly identical. No fantasy or CGI feel.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张展示上传主厨刀的逼真专业餐厅后厨场景。

场景：高端西餐备餐区，不锈钢台面、整齐配菜、新鲜蛋白与蔬菜。

展示：厨师手部精准用刀、干净利落的切口、专业氛围与真实厨房灯光。

风格：美食纪录片 / 米其林厨房商业摄影。传递锋利、掌控与专业可靠。

刀具保持完全一致。禁止幻想或 CGI 感。

subcategories.title: Santoku / Nakiri · 精准切片与蔬果料理
subcategories.scene_desc: 三德刀/菜刀适合精细切片。极简现代厨房，强调刃口控制与干净切口。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic Japanese-inspired modern Western kitchen scene using the uploaded santoku or nakiri knife.

Scene: minimal clean kitchen with light wood and stone surfaces, soft natural window light.

Show: precise vertical slicing of fresh vegetables or herbs on a wooden board, clean paper-thin cuts, focused hand control.

Mood: precision, craftsmanship, balance, healthy cooking.

Style: professional culinary photography preferred by US and European home cooks who value Japanese knife performance.

Keep product 100% identical.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张使用上传三德刀或菜刀的日式灵感现代欧美厨房场景。

场景：极简干净厨房，浅色木与石材台面、柔和窗光。

展示：在木砧板上对新鲜蔬果或香草做垂直精准切片、薄如蝉翼的切口、专注手部控制。

氛围：精准、工艺、平衡、健康烹饪。

风格：受美欧家庭厨娘欢迎的专业美食摄影，强调日式刀具性能。

产品保持 100% 一致。

subcategories.title: Cleaver / Butcher · 厚切与肉类处理
subcategories.scene_desc: 砍骨刀/屠宰刀。厚砧板、生鲜肉块、有力但安全的手部动作，欧美肉类料理审美。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic premium meat preparation scene featuring the uploaded cleaver or butcher knife.

Scene: modern Western kitchen or small butcher-style prep station with thick wooden board, fresh cuts of meat, clean stainless or stone surfaces.

Show: confident controlled hand movement portioning meat, realistic weight and presence of the cleaver, professional but approachable atmosphere.

Style: American/European food commercial photography. Communicate power, durability, and craftsmanship without looking aggressive or weapon-like.

Keep the knife identical to the reference.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张展示上传砍骨刀或屠宰刀的逼真高端肉类处理场景。

场景：现代西厨或小型肉铺式备餐台，厚木砧板、新鲜肉块、干净不锈钢或石材台面。

展示：沉稳有力的手部分割肉类、砍刀真实的重量感与存在感、专业但亲和的氛围。

风格：美欧美食商业摄影。传递力量、耐用与工艺，避免攻击性或武器化观感。

刀具与参考图保持一致。

subcategories.title: Bread / Slicing · 烘焙与切片场景
subcategories.scene_desc: 面包刀/切片刀。家用烘焙厨房，法棍、面粉、温馨晨光。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic home bakery lifestyle photograph featuring the uploaded bread or slicing knife.

Scene: warm European-style home kitchen with artisan sourdough or baguette, flour dust, wooden board, soft morning window light.

Show: natural hand slicing bread with clean even cuts, cozy authentic atmosphere.

Style: premium bakery magazine photography popular in US and European lifestyle brands.

Keep the knife exactly identical.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张展示上传面包刀或切片刀的逼真家用烘焙生活方式照片。

场景：温馨欧式家庭厨房，手工酸面团或法棍、面粉、木质砧板、柔和晨间窗光。

展示：自然手部均匀切片面包、干净切口、真实温馨氛围。

风格：美欧生活方式品牌常见的高端烘焙杂志摄影。

刀具保持完全一致。

subcategories.title: Kitchen Knife Sets · 套装礼盒与台面展示
subcategories.scene_desc: 多件套/礼盒装。高端厨房台面或礼品包装，适合提升客单与节日营销。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a premium kitchen knife set presentation photograph using the uploaded knife set or main knife from the set.

Scene: elegant modern Western kitchen countertop or dining surface with matching block or gift packaging, soft natural light, minimal premium props (wood, linen, herbs).

Composition: clean catalog-style arrangement, product as hero, suitable for Shopify product page and gift marketing.

Style: high-end kitchenware brand photography (US/EU aesthetic). Keep all products identical to references.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张展示上传刀具套装或主刀的高端厨刀套装陈列照片。

场景：优雅现代西厨台面或餐桌，配套刀座或礼盒包装，柔和自然光，极简高端道具（木、亚麻、香草）。

构图：干净画册式排列，产品为主体，适合 Shopify 产品页与礼品营销。

风格：美欧审美的高端厨具品牌摄影。所有产品与参考保持一致。

subcategories.title: Kitchen Knife · 美式后院 BBQ 备餐
subcategories.scene_desc: 户外烧烤备肉。美国后院、烤架、木质备餐桌，周末生活方式。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic American backyard BBQ preparation scene featuring the uploaded kitchen knife.

Scene: suburban patio with stainless grill, wooden prep table, raw meat and vegetables ready for grilling, warm golden-hour sunlight.

Show: natural outdoor cooking action, authentic weekend lifestyle mood popular with US customers.

Style: American lifestyle food advertising photography. Keep knife identical.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张展示上传厨刀的逼真美式后院 BBQ 备餐场景。

场景：郊区露台、不锈钢烤架、木质备餐桌、待烤的肉与蔬菜、金色小时暖光。

展示：自然的户外烹饪动作、受美国客户欢迎的真实周末生活方式氛围。

风格：美式生活方式美食广告摄影。刀具保持一致。

subcategories.title: Kitchen Knife · 感恩节 / 圣诞家庭厨房
subcategories.scene_desc: 欧美节日营销。温馨家庭厨房、节日食材、暖光与轻微节日装饰。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic holiday family cooking scene for Thanksgiving or Christmas featuring the uploaded kitchen knife.

Scene: warm European-American family kitchen with seasonal ingredients, wooden board, soft warm lighting, subtle festive elements in background (not cluttered).

Mood: family tradition, quality cooking, trust, togetherness.

Style: premium holiday kitchen advertisement photography for Western markets. Keep knife identical.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作感恩节或圣诞节家庭烹饪的逼真场景，展示上传厨刀。

场景：温馨欧美家庭厨房、时令食材、木质砧板、柔和暖光、背景轻微节日元素（不杂乱）。

氛围：家庭传统、品质烹饪、信任与团聚。

风格：面向西方市场的高端节日厨房广告摄影。刀具保持一致。

subcategories.title: Kitchen Knife · 刀刃微距质感卖点图
subcategories.scene_desc: 详情页核心卖点。聚焦刃口、钢材、手柄材质，背景虚化厨房。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a premium macro product photograph focusing on the uploaded kitchen knife details.

Show: blade texture, steel finish, sharp edge line, handle material and rivets.

Background: softly blurred premium Western kitchen.

Lighting: professional studio mixed with natural reflections.

Style: luxury knife brand detail shot. Do not change any product details — enhance realism only.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张聚焦上传厨刀细节的高端微距产品照片。

展示：刀刃纹理、钢材表面、锋利刃线、手柄材质与铆钉。

背景：虚化的高端西厨。

光线：专业影棚光结合自然反射。

风格：奢侈刀具品牌细节图。禁止改动产品细节，仅增强真实感。

subcategories.title: Kitchen Knife · 独立站 16:9 Hero Banner
subcategories.scene_desc: 官网首页第一屏。产品偏右，左侧留白放标题与 CTA。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a premium website hero banner for a kitchen knife brand targeting US and European customers.

Use the uploaded knife as the hero product placed on the right side of a beautiful modern Western kitchen scene.

Leave clean negative space on the left for headline and CTA.

Lighting: natural morning commercial light.

Style: luxury international kitchenware brand campaign. Must look like a real professional photograph.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
为面向美欧客户的厨刀品牌制作一张高端网站 Hero Banner。

上传刀具作为主角，置于美丽现代西厨场景右侧。

左侧留出干净负空间放置标题与 CTA。

光线：自然晨间商业光。

风格：国际厨具品牌高端广告片。必须像真实专业照片。

subcategories.title: Bushcraft · 森林营地切绳与削木
subcategories.scene_desc: 丛林生存刀典型场景。温带针叶林营地、木头、伞绳，户外发烧友质感。
subcategories.prompt:
Create a realistic outdoor bushcraft lifestyle photograph featuring the uploaded fixed blade knife.

Scene: dense North American pine forest campsite, wooden log workbench, paracord, campfire smoke in background, natural overcast daylight.

Show: male hands with work gloves using the knife to shave feather sticks or slice paracord with precision.

Style: rugged outdoor gear commercial photography popular on US gear blogs and Amazon US. Authentic, durable, field-tested vibe.

Keep knife 100% identical.
subcategories.prompt_zh:
制作一张展示上传直刀的逼真户外丛林生存生活方式照片。

场景：北美密林营地、木桩台、伞绳、背景篝火微烟、自然阴天光线。

展示：戴防磨手套的男士手部用刀精准削木花或切断伞绳。

风格：美欧装备博客与 AmazonUS 常见的硬核户外装备商业摄影。真实、耐用、实战感。

刀具保持 100% 一致。

subcategories.title: Camping · 帐篷营地户外餐备料
subcategories.scene_desc: 折叠刀/户外小直刀。轻量化露营、折叠桌、煎锅与野餐食材。
subcategories.prompt:
